objective: The new elephants in the game: the Elephant and the Frost Mammoth get the faceted, textured models of decision 0051, and the War Elephant joins as the Elephant's legendary variant (twist strength).
acceptance_criteria: The Elephant, the Frost Mammoth and the War Elephant load in the game with the new models, rigged and animated like every creature
A legendary roll on a Titan hatches a War Elephant; a mythic roll still hatches a Frost Mammoth; no other odds change
The elephants' clips fit the new models
verification: 2026-11-15: upload-assets run 43749504282 succeeded (three models, three textures), after a first run (43748916603) whose models came out too dark in the game because they carried vertex colours; kit.py now drops them after the bake. Lune 687/687, selene and stylua clean. In Studio (local build): the Elephant, the Frost Mammoth and the War Elephant load with the new models and match the concept cards; the attack slam, the power wind-up and the defeat were frozen and looked at on the models and fit without changes; a test wave 6 with a Lion and the Elephant as the Titan was won with no script errors. Not checked: the walk and the win pose by eye, phones, two players, a War Elephant from a real hatch, the War Elephant in a fight.
notes: SHANNON chose the textured elephants on 2026-11-15 and asked to continue. The upload runs in GitHub (environment assets), never with a key on this machine.
